text:
sara: Hey team — I clicked a 'company benefits survey' link from onboarding@payroll-corp.com during lunch. It asked me to 'Sign in with SSO' and I entered my email; I think I may have entered my password. I didn't give 2FA code.

maya (sec-eng): @sara thanks for reporting. Please do not change anything else yet. Can you forward the original email to sec-reports@redwood.com and paste a screenshot of the form? We're going to check SSO logs and token activity.

jon (it): @sara can you confirm whether you used work device or personal? Also do you have 2FA enabled?

sara: Work laptop. 2FA is enabled but I didn't enter the code, just email+password. Forwarded the email and screenshot.

phish-bot: New phishing report created: PR-4571. Sandbox analysis queued (job 9876).

maya (sec-eng): Quick triage notes:
- Email came from onboarding@payroll-corp.com (spoofed).
- Link redirects: https://blob.core.windows.net/forms/xyz -> https://payroll-login[.]info/form
- Form posts to https://api-payroll-auth[.]com/collect

maya (sec-eng): Sandbox results attached:
```
$ curl -I https://blob.core.windows.net/forms/xyz
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Server: Microsoft-Azure-Blob/1.0
```
No executable payloads detected. Form is a credential harvester.

maya (sec-eng): Containment actions recommended and taken:
- Forced SSO session revoke for sara@example.com immediately.
- Rotated OAuth client secret for partner onboarding flow.
- Blocked outbound DNS for api-payroll-auth.com at edge.
- Added sender domain to blocklist and flagged similar mail patterns for quarantine.

jon (it): Actions done: revoked sessions, pushed OAuth secret rotate (rollout id 2201). Applied DNS block at perimeter. Sending password reset notice to sara.

alice (sre): Suggest we send a short awareness note to current onboarding cohort and patch the internal onboarding checklist to validate vendor domains and SPF/DKIM before sending invites.

maya (sec-eng): Agreed. Also create an incident short summary for compliance. I'll open SEC-4571 and assign remediation tasks.

sara: Thanks everyone. I reset my password after you asked and verified my MFA devices. Feeling ok now.

maya (sec-eng): Follow-up items:
- Update onboarding playbook (owner: people-ops)
- Add automated header checks to inbound-source scanning (owner: eng-mailops)
- Run a query to find other clicks from same blob URL (owner: sec-eng)
Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4571 :thumbsup:

jon (it): Will add an optional blocklist rule in the next perimeter release.

alice (sre): I'll draft the awareness blurb and share in #announcements for approval.

maya (sec-eng): Closing thread for now, will re-open in 24h if we see additional hits. Thanks @sara and team.
